statement: Final assessment of the three distinctions: (iii) validity/as-of semantics is conceptually pre-empted (bitemporal valid-time correctness, point-in-time resolution named as a legality-critical operation), so it cannot be a novelty claim; (ii) clause-granularity versioning is a recognized but explicitly unaddressed gap, so the benchmark is valuable while the identification of the gap is not novel; (i) retrieval-time (as opposed to representation-level) temporal enforcement is described as under-explored, which supports the rationale for a post-hoc ranking layer but remains an untested framing until measured across retrievers. The contribution therefore rests on measurement and retrieval-time enforcement, not on identifying the problem or naming the signal.

evidence.quote: most solutions remain stronger at representation than at retrieval-time enforcement
